Source JSONs are game-reverse-engineering PR #61 (OPEN, not merged at wiring time) at teardown/tekken7-steam/tkdata/mothead/json/. Per-move map: workspace t7-motbin-analysis/frv_move_clip_map.csv, report T7-MOTBIN-FRV-DNC-2026-10-24.md. Join key: anim_ref = bank + index into the bank MOTA offset list.
t7_motbin_clips.playable_wiring: NONE. No WH move in this file was given a mot.bin clip as its playable animation, and no existing anim_ref was changed. Reason: the display-title to internal-move join is NOT play-verified (decode report section 7: only 30 frv + 11 dnc titles walk deterministically, several collide on one landing move, and dnc walks land on the walk-forward state Dc_sWALKF). Wiring those walks as playable animations would be guessing. This table wires clip KEYS only; a later lane may attach clips to WH moves only after play verification, one move at a time.

frame_convention: Frames and damage from T7 Master Raven frame data (60fps). Damage scaled x0.6 to WH 100HP (T7 ~175HP scale). Startup = T7 speed frames / 60. on_block/on_hit/on_ch carried verbatim from the T7 data. Stances renamed to Pond's canon (HAZ->MIST, LAB->DEEP WATER, Shadow Sprint->WATER STRIDE); iconic Raven names kept where they fit the swamp (Basilisk Fang, Quicksand Catastrophe, Skull Rave). Canon specials (TONGUE LASH, STILL WATER, EGG GUARD, MIST VEIL, BOUNDARY CROSSING) layered on top.
canon_note: Pond is Raven's Western Heart replacement. Swamp boundary watcher; found Dorowani as an egg and guarded it. Moveset = Master Raven's Tekken 7 kit translated to her still-water body: the teleports become mist, the cruelty becomes patience. Voice: sparse, imagistic, Japanese-influenced. 'The pond does not chase.'
